messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON notifies the MPOO about equipment change intentions. The MPOO announces self dismounting to the MPON or the MPOO shall notify the MPON about no self-dismounting of the MPOO. The MPON or the MPOO perform the final reading. The MPON or the MPOO dismount the old equipment. The MPON mounts the new device. The MPON reads the meter count from the installed meter. The MPON sents the values of the final reading to the GO. The MPON tells the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation. The GO shall notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting, and the meter count at installation.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="EquipmentChangeProcess" name="Equipment Change Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- Step 1: MPON notifies MPOO -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Notifies_MPOO" name="MPON notifies MPOO about equipment change intentions">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmndi:bpmndi xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI">
          <bpmndi:BPMNShape bpmnElement="Task_MPON_Notifies_MPOO" id="BPMNShape_Task_MPON_Notifies_MPOO">
            <omgdc:Bounds x="152" y="102" width="100" height="80" xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"/>
          </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
        </bpmndi:bpmndi>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Step 2: MPOO Decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" name="MPOO Self-Dismounting Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3_SelfDismount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3_NoSelfDismount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Branch A: Self Dismounting Announced -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOO_Announces_SelfDismount" name="MPOO announces self dismounting to MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3_SelfDismount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4_Converge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Branch B: No Self Dismounting Notified -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOO_Notifies_NoSelfDismount" name="MPOO notifies MPON about no self-dismounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3_NoSelfDismount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4_Converge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Convergence Point -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3_SelfDismount" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_MPOO_Announces_SelfDismount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Self Dismounting</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3_NoSelfDismount" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_MPOO_Notifies_NoSelfDismount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No Self Dismounting</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4_Converge" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_Announces_SelfDismount" targetRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Performer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4_Converge_B" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_Notifies_NoSelfDismount" targetRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Performer"/>

    <!-- Step 3: Final Reading Performer Decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalReading_Performer" name="Who performs final reading?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4_Converge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4_Converge_B</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5_MPON_Reads</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5_MPOO_Reads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_FinalReading" name="MPON performs final reading">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5_MPON_Reads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6_Converge_Dismount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOO_FinalReading" name="MPOO performs final reading">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5_MPOO_Reads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6_Converge_Dismount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_MPON_Reads" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Performer" targetRef="Task_MPON_FinalReading">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">MPON</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_MPOO_Reads" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Performer" targetRef="Task_MPOO_FinalReading">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">MPOO</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Step 4: Dismount Old Equipment Performer Decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Dismount_Performer" name="Who dismounts old equipment?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6_Converge_Dismount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7_MPON_Dismounts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7_MPOO_Dismounts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Dismounts_Old" name="MPON dismounts old equipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7_MPON_Dismounts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8_To_MountNew</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPOO_Dismounts_Old" name="MPOO dismounts old equipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7_MPOO_Dismounts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8_To_MountNew</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6_Converge_Dismount" sourceRef="Task_MPON_FinalReading" targetRef="Gateway_Dismount_Performer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6_Converge_Dismount_B" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_FinalReading" targetRef="Gateway_Dismount_Performer"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7_MPON_Dismounts" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismount_Performer" targetRef="Task_MPON_Dismounts_Old">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">MPON</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7_MPOO_Dismounts" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismount_Performer" targetRef="Task_MPOO_Dismounts_Old">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">MPOO</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Step 5: MPON Mounts New Device -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Mounts_New" name="MPON mounts the new device">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8_To_MountNew</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9_To_ReadMeter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8_To_MountNew" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Dismounts_Old" targetRef="Task_MPON_Mounts_New"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8_To_MountNew_B" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_Dismounts_Old" targetRef="Task_MPON_Mounts_New"/>

    <!-- Step 6: MPON Reads Meter Count -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Reads_Meter" name="MPON reads meter count from installed meter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9_To_ReadMeter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10_To_SendFinalReading</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9_To_ReadMeter" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Mounts_New" targetRef="Task_MPON_Reads_Meter"/>

    <!-- Step 7: MPON Sends Final Reading to GO -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Sends_FinalReading_GO" name="MPON sends values of final reading to GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10_To_SendFinalReading</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11_To_TellGO_DeviceChanges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_To_SendFinalReading" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Reads_Meter" targetRef="Task_MPON_Sends_FinalReading_GO"/>

    <!-- Step 8: MPON Tells GO about Device Changes, Master Data, Meter Count at Installation -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MPON_Tells_GO_Details" name="MPON tells GO about device changes, master data and meter count at installation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11_To_TellGO_DeviceChanges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12_To_GoNotifyMSP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11_To_TellGO_DeviceChanges" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Sends_FinalReading_GO" targetRef="Task_MPON_Tells_GO_Details"/>

    <!-- Step 9: GO Notifies MSP -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GO_Notifies_MSP" name="GO notifies MSP about device changes, master data, meter count at dismounting, and meter count at installation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12_To_GoNotifyMSP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12_To_GoNotifyMSP" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Tells_GO_Details" targetRef="Task_GO_Notifies_MSP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13_To_End" sourceRef="Task_GO_Notifies_MSP" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>

    <!-- Initial Flow -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_MPON_Notifies_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_MPON_Notifies_MPOO" targetRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision"/>

  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="EquipmentChangeProcess"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
